content.value: If possible find the value of m so that the following system of linear (15) equations has (i) no solution (ii) unique soiution (iii) many (arbitrary) solutions. Give $2 m x + y = m ; 2 x + 3 m y = 1$ . In the case of existing solution for some m, find the solution(s).
